header.title: We Are MotelLease Tech
header.subtitle: At MotelLease Tech, we believe in simplifying the rental experience for everyone. Our platform bridges the gap between landlords and tenants by providing a seamless, efficient, and transparent rental process. From helping tenants find their ideal rental properties to giving landlords tools to manage their listings, we strive to make the process stress-free and modern.

team.title: Meet Our Team
members: To Do Hong Y - Website Developer
team.goal: To create a platform that connects tenants and landlords efficiently, using modern technology.

project.title: Why This Project & Goals
project.why: Addressing real-world problems: Difficulty in finding and managing rental properties, leveraging technology to optimize the rental process for both tenants and landlords, and aligning with market trends and the growing demand for digital platforms.
project.goals: Build a platform that connects landlords and tenants easily, provide features like online booking, electronic payments, and contract management, and enhance the rental experience by utilizing modern technologies.

technologies.title: Technologies & Future Vision
technologies.used: ReactJS, Node.js, MongoDB, integration with electronic payment systems (Momo, VNPay), and modern deployment and security tools (CI/CD, Cloud Hosting).
technologies.future: Adding features like user reviews and feedback, expanding the platform to cover more regions, and enhancing user experience with AI-powered rental recommendations.
